title: Jamaican Cheese Bake
description: A delightful twist on a classic casserole, this Jamaican cheese bake combines the flavors of the Caribbean with a creamy, cheesy delight.
instructions: In a large skillet, sauté the onions and tomatoes until softened.
In a separate bowl, mix breadcrumbs and allspice.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the tomato mixture.
Sprinkle with half of the breadcrumbs and half of the cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
